fields.chief_complaint: Patient presents with intermittent chest tightness and shortness of breath on exertion over the past three weeks. No prior cardiac history reported.
fields.findings: General: Alert and oriented, in no acute distress. Cardiovascular: Regular rate and rhythm; soft systolic murmur at left sternal border. Respiratory: Clear bilaterally. ECG: Mild ST-segment changes.
fields.assessment: Stage 1 hypertension; exertional chest discomfort pending cardiac stress test and lipid panel.
